slots.brief: The Sealing Gate — A slab of black basalt grinds inch by inch across the only known door into the Underlight, the failing land below. A gaunt gate-warden named Yssa Grae
The Warden's Archive — Shelves of cracked ledgers and rolled charts line the gatehouse walls. A half-burned map fragment shows a shortcut through the old beacon causeway, if
Yssa Grae's Warning — Yssa Grae's voice is flat with exhaustion. 'The way closes on its own hour. I can't stop it, and I won't lie about that. But I can trade you what I kn
The Forgotten Stores — Behind a collapsed shelf, a cache of oil, rope, and rations sits undisturbed. Something has been gnawing at the crates from below the floorboards.
The Guttering Causeway — A stone bridge stretches over a black chasm, lit only by beacon-cages that flicker like dying hearts. Some have already gone dark. Shapes seem to gath
The Drowned Shrine — Below the causeway lies a half-flooded shrine to whatever kept the first beacons burning. Ritual markings describe a key of light that can be coaxed f
Nest in the Walls — Dozens of red eyes catch the last of the light as a swarm of oversized rats pours from the cracks in the stone.
What the Dark Kept — The shrine's shadows peel away from the walls, hungry for warmth and years long denied it.
The Failing Tower — The beacon tower's mechanism groans, its light reduced to a dying coal. Hobgoblin sentries who serve some older, colder master guard the controls.
The Tower's Wardens — Hobgoblin sentries and their loping wolves bar the way to the beacon controls, disciplined and unwilling to yield ground.
The Last Hour — Behind you, the gate has nearly closed. Ahead, the tunnels themselves seem to be narrowing, stone easing shut like a fist.
The Choice at the Threshold — The beacon-light steadies, however briefly. The way home is open again, for now. What you do with this reprieve will decide how this land remembers yo
A Grey and Grudging Light — You climb back into a sky that has no sun but is, at least, not sealed shut. The Underlight remains below, beacons guttering, waiting for someone else
The New Warden — You take up a post beside the gate, tending what light remains so that others might one day pass through safely. It is a lonely vigil, but not an unwo
The Door Unmade — You bring the way down behind you in a roar of collapsing stone. Whatever waited in the Underlight will wait forever now, and no one else will ever ha
Swallowed by the Dark — The last beacon dies. The gate finishes its long, grinding closure with you still on the wrong side of it. The Underlight keeps what it takes.
